description:
Classify underlying claim-command I/O failures through the shared typed-error classifier before applying command-specific JSON fallbacks, so claim failures report the same class and exit status in plain and machine-readable forms.

## Background

The claim JSON helper preserves a special no-Git mapping but otherwise applies a command-specific fallback code. That fallback can hide a reachable permission or external I/O cause that the plain path classifies as a filesystem or external failure, producing different statuses for the same failure. Command-specific claim codes remain appropriate only when no more specific typed class applies.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A claim JSON failure with a classifiable underlying I/O cause reports the registered shared error code for that cause before any command-specific fallback is considered.
- [hard] REQ-02: Permission-denied and external-I/O claim failures exit with the status mapped from their reported code, equal to the identical plain invocation.
- [hard] REQ-03: The explicit no-Git claim mapping and command-specific fallbacks for otherwise unclassified claim failures remain intact.
- [hard] REQ-04: Integration coverage drives reachable underlying claim I/O failures through plain and JSON forms and asserts equal status, canonical envelope shape, code, and payload-stream purity.
title: Classify underlying claim I/O failures uniformly
